about: Constants of the flight model that are the same for every ship class. Ship numbers are in Resources/Ships/<class>.json. Sources are FS2's source (github.com/ptitSeb/freespace2), read for behaviour only; the code is our own.

autoBankFraction.source: FS2 physics.cpp physics_read_flying_controls: roll goal -= yaw stick x max YAW rate / 2 (banks into the turn)

rampShortcutDivisor.source: FS2 physics.cpp velocity_ramp: when the speed gap (m/s) is under time constant / 3, the time constant becomes gap / 3, so speed lands on its goal in finite time

rampSnapTimeConstant.source: FS2 physics.cpp velocity_ramp: below this time constant the speed snaps to its goal

afterburnerRestartLockout.source: FS2 afterburner.cpp afterburners_start: 1300 ms between starts (player)

afterburnerRechargeScale.source: FS2 afterburner.cpp afterburners_update: rec rate x engine ETS share (default 0.333, hudets.cpp) x 2 x skill scale (3.0 at FS2's default skill, Easy). Medium would be 1.332.

knockTime.source: FS2 physics.cpp REDUCED_DAMP_TIME (2000 ms); also SW_BLAST_DURATION for shockwave shake

knockDampFactor.source: FS2 physics.cpp REDUCED_DAMP_FACTOR: sideways damping x (1 + 9f), forward damping side damp x 10f, f = fraction of the knock time left

knockFullSpeedChange.source: FS2 physics.cpp REDUCED_DAMP_VEL: a knock of this velocity change loosens damping for the whole knock time; smaller ones proportionally less

knockSpin.source: FS2 physics.cpp ROTVEL_WHACK_CONST: off-centre impulse to turn rate scale

shockTurnDampFactor.source: FS2 physics.cpp SW_ROT_FACTOR: turn damping x (1 + 4f) while a shockwave fades

shockShake.source: Ours: FS2 shakes the orientation directly (MAX_SHAKE 0.1); we add a smooth noise to the turn rate instead so render interpolation stays smooth. Placeholder until the juice sandbox tunes it.

maxTurnRate.source: FS2 physics.cpp ROTVEL_CAP: knocks cannot spin a ship faster than this

matchSpeedCancel.source: Ours: moving the throttle by more than this cancels match speed (FS2 cancels it on any throttle key)
